_about: Richard Alleine (1611-1681), ejected minister of Batcombe, Somerset: Heaven Opened, or a brief and plain discovery of the riches of God's covenant of grace (London: Religious Tract Society, undated, catalogued 1848; the scan is a bound volume of the Society's series that also holds Samuel Shaw's Immanuel). Vindiciae Pietatis (1663) is pending: its title page prints only 'R. A.' Named richard-alleine because lane A's alleine shelf is Joseph Alleine. Internet Archive OCR, raw and unconverted; each title page read before listing.
